Object is the **near-session XLC environment**, not SPX and not a stock pick. XLC remains a two-name duration/growth book (META ~16.4–16.7%, Alphabet A+C ~18.5%, NFLX ~4.8–4.9%).

## Channel 2

**1. Shared macro → this sector.** Risk-on helps XLC **only if mega-cap growth participates**. This morning it does **not**: NQ **−0.19%** / ES **0.0%** is the mapping that matters, and yesterday’s NQ impulse was **NVDA/XLK**, which XLC **did not own and did not follow** (XLK +3.16% vs XLC −1.07%; META −0.87%, GOOGL −0.39%). Sticky July **core PCE 3.3% unchanged / headline 3.7%** already reopened hike bets — that print is **T-1/T-2, not today’s 8:30**. Live load-bearing event is **Warsh’s first Jackson Hole keynote ~10:00 ET** (two-sided: frame inflation/credibility vs no near-term hike signal; Sep hike odds still only ~34–40%). Also on the clock: Chicago PMI ~9:45 (cons ~58 vs 57.6) and **UMich final ~51.0** at 10:00 — not a comms spine. Real yields are **not a fresh crush** (DFII10 +2 bp 1d, still −7 bp 1m). Oil is **down**, so 08-11/08-12 geo cap does **not** fire. Europe is a genuine red composite, not a single-name outlier. **S0 stays 0** — 08-27 forbids mapping leftover NVDA beta into S0=+1; 08-21 forbids flipping S0 to −1 on already-printed PCE.

**2. Spine (mandatory).** Digital-ad recovery and AI monetization **proof** are both still real (Meta Q2 ads ~$59.4B +27%; eMarketer 2026 Meta ads ~$243.5B vs Google ~$239.5B; Advantage+ run-rate; Alphabet Search/YouTube + Cloud). Per 08-11 they are **one ad/AI thesis**, not two — and they are **structural, not a same-morning print**. No fresh ad-recession signal. Regulatory: **refresh legal state** — Meta **settled** the 29-state teen case **08-26** (~$16.7B headline / ~$10B Q3 accrual / YouTube-contingent). Premarket pop ~+4% **gave back** into the close (+1.07% 08-26, −0.87% 08-27). That is **stale-resolved**, not a fresh trial open and **not** 08-17/08-18 severe. Alphabet antitrust remains **structural** (Teads follow-on filed Aug 3; ad-tech remedies still pending) — not a same-morning shock. Capex vs FCF tension is still the caveat, not a new number.

**3. Secondary.** Engagement/MAU with monetization: checked, nothing material. Antitrust **relief**: the Meta deal is child-safety, **not** an Alphabet remedy — nothing material. Telecom ARPU/subscriber: **AMX upgrade is not an XLC driver**. Engagement deceleration: AppLovin PT cut to $325 is ad-tech adjacent, **not** META/GOOGL. Telecom price war: nothing material. Rotation **out** of comms is **already on the tape** (1d/3d/1m all lag) — counted in S2/S4, not again as an S1 HIT.

**4. Breadth / leadership.** 08-27 was **XLK-only**: META faded after the settlement bounce, GOOGL slipped, NFLX ~−2%. That is **large-cap failure inside the sector**, not mega-name carry that can be ignored. Premarket 08-28: no dual-leader rip (META/GOOGL last prints mixed-to-soft; NFLX AH ~+0.4% is noise). Single-ticker APP/AMX/CRM/CRWD **must not** drive the ETF call. CRM/CRWD software rally is **XLK/IGV**, not XLC.

**5. Flows / positioning.** ETFdb (late Aug): XLC **5d ~−$206M, 1m ~−$400M, 3m ~−$1.94B**. Units left while the book lagged — near-term demand is **not** supporting. Crowding is mega-cap + unresolved capex, **not** an extreme 1d relative spike (1m rel is **−3.97%**). Prior-week flow is **not** same-day support (08-11).

**6. Earnings / policy.** No fresh META/GOOGL/NFLX print. **NVDA is already public** (08-26 AHR) and **already isolated** into XLK on 08-27. Warsh 10:00 ET is the session binary for duration/growth. UMich/Chicago PMI are secondary and two-sided.

## Lessons / audit

- **08-27 (live):** Do **not** repeat yesterday’s miss. S0 = **0**, not +1. Direction **not up**.
- **08-21:** Futures are **not** ≥+0.3% → no S0+ flip. Stale PCE → no S0−.
- **08-13:** Oil falling + no fresh Hormuz spike → do **not** restack geo down/notable.
- **08-14:** 1d rel **−1.72%** is a lag, not a >+1% reversal follow-through. Score the lag **once** as confirmation (S4) plus composition (S2), not as a third S1 hit.
- **08-17/08-18:** Settlement is **one-name, already traded**; Alphabet not under a fresh same-morning legal shock; **severe off**. Offset scan not required to veto severe because severe is not in play.
- **08-11:** Ad+AI counted **once**. Live geo suppressor **absent**.
- Leading sum (S0+S1+S2+S3) = **−2** vs S4 **−1** → **no divergence**; factors and tape agree on no-up. Trust factors; tape confirms the lag.
- Same-shock: NVDA/NQ counted **only** as “not XLC participation,” not again as sector leadership.
- Rolling mag **0.1** + Warsh two-sided → **multiplier 0.9**, band **mild/flat**, not notable.

Near-session XLC setup is a **laggard duration/growth book into a two-sided Fed-chair speech, with no fresh comms spine and a decisive relative tape**. That is **down/mild**, not an up call and not a dump.
